parse_datetime_basic: parse a datetime string in ISO 8601 format with trailing Z to a UTC datetime object
parse_datetime_no_fraction: parse a datetime string without fractional seconds like 2024-11-16T00:27:02Z to a UTC datetime
parse_datetime_long_fraction: parse a datetime string with 9-digit fractional seconds and truncate to 6 digits
parse_datetime_invalid: handle a ValueError when an invalid datetime string is passed to parse_datetime
parse_datetime_timezone: parse a datetime string and ensure the resulting datetime object has UTC timezone info
